0022600196.text: The Bulls (1-7, 0-2 at home, 14th in the East, on a six-game losing streak) host the Philadelphia 76ers (8-2, 1st in the East and 1st in the Atlantic, 8-2 in their last ten), with Chicago 5 games back in the Central. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring strain, while Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. For Philadelphia, Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture) are out, and Adem Bona (back sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Bulls trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 126-107 in Philadelphia on November 2, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
